artworks.title: The Long Gallery, Louvre
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of the interior of an art gallery or museum. The image features a spacious hall with high ceilings and walls adorned with framed artworks. There are indistinct figures sketched throughout the space, suggesting movement and interaction among them. The architectural details indicate a grand space characterized by columns and archways. The use of light and shadow emphasizes the scale and depth of the interior. The drawing captures the ambiance of a cultural setting, focusing on the interaction between the structural space and the role it plays in hosting art.

artworks.title: The Whitesmiths, Impasse des Carmélites
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of a classical architectural facade with a large central opening, showcasing the entrance of a building supported by two columns. The top of the structure features an ornate rounded arch. Loose and sketchy pencil strokes create an impressionistic feel, with a monochromatic color palette of light tan and black. Figures within the entrance appear engaged in a workshop or laborious activity, adding life to the scene. The background is undefined, focusing attention on the central activity and architectural details.

artworks.title: Tête-à-tête in the Garden
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch depicting a scene with a table where two figures sit in a café or outdoor setting. There is no clear horizon line visible, and the focus is more on the immediate scene. The sketch is made with loose charcoal or pencil strokes capturing the impression of the scene rather than detailed specifics. The lines vary in intensity, with denser areas where the foliage creates shade and where the figures are sitting. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black and gray on a light beige or cream paper. The table is laid out with what appears to be bottles and glasses in the foreground. In the background, there are lightly sketched lines depicting elements like a railing, furniture, and trees or vines, adding depth to the sketch.

artworks.title: The Terrace, Luxembourg
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch featuring several figures, with the lower parts of their bodies visible. Some figures are sitting while others are standing. The seated figures seem to be sitting on chairs and are likely women wearing long dresses and hats with brims. The standing figure to the right is in a side profile, also wearing a long dress and a hat, with another small figure nearby. The figures are not detailed, consistent with the sketch's minimalist style. They are dressed in attire indicative of an earlier era. Surrounding the figures is a railing or balcony, with a large decorative vase holding plants or flowers. In the background, there is a faint outline hinting at a large building or structure with sketched tree branches extending above the people in the foreground. The composition is a pencil drawing on a plain background, with a light and airy feel.

artworks.title: The Little Café au Bois
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor café scene with tables and chairs.

artworks.title: Late Picquet
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of several people situated around a table indoors. Two individuals are visible sitting at the table, with one person's back slightly turned. Both individuals have simple hair styles, and their facial features are minimally detailed. The clothing is suggested with basic lines, and one person appears to be wearing a hat. There is no clear depiction of jewelry or objects being held. The background is roughly sketched with shading hinting at a window or architectural detail. The focus is on the figures, with surrounding lines giving context.

artworks.title: The Laundress: "La Blanchisseuse de la Place Dauphine"
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a shopfront. The artwork features a simple yet detailed illustration of shop's exterior. The drawing highlights glass windows with shapes inside along with slightly blurred figures. Curtains are partially open, revealing glimpses of the interior. Above the windows is an inscription that possibly displays the establishment's name or purpose. The sketched lines are delicate yet purposeful, emphasizing architectural features over intricate details.

artworks.title: Rue Furstenburg
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a street scene from an elevated point of view. The sketch shows a narrow urban street leading towards a cluster of buildings. The artwork features loose and impressionistic brushstrokes, with a monochromatic color palette of black lines on a cream-colored background. Figures with minimal detail are close to the viewer, while more figures and buildings can be seen further into the scene. The distant elements are less defined, leaving room for viewer interpretation.

artworks.title: Confidences in the Garden
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals standing closely together with their backs to the viewer. The person on the left is wearing a long dress and appears to have their head turned to the right. The person on the right is head-turned toward the left and is wearing a hat and a long coat or dress. Both individuals seem to be embracing or engaged in conversation. Surrounding them are delicately drawn plants and flowers, suggesting a garden setting. In the background, there is a sketched structure resembling a building wall with architectural details like a large arch-like feature and a column or vertical beam supporting an overhead element. The overall ambiance of the image is serene and soft, created by the light, sketchy lines.

artworks.title: La Jolie New Yorkaise
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a woman sitting at a table. The woman is upright, slightly angled to her left, and facing forward. She has softly sketched facial features and styled hair with a hat featuring a feather. She is wearing a textured garment, possibly a dress with a high collar and voluminous sleeves. Sitting next to a round table, there is a teacup and saucer. The background is minimally detailed with faint lines suggesting interior elements.

artworks.title: La Belle Dame Paresseuse
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a charcoal or pencil sketch of an abstract figure seated, seen from the head down to the knees. The figure is turned to the right, with the head resting on the hand. The facial features are minimal, showing only the eyes, nose, and mouth. The hair is medium-length and flowing. The clothing is suggested with shaded texture, possibly a dress or long garment. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is simple, with light pencil strokes and open space, emphasizing the figure.

artworks.title: La Belle Jardinière
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The sketch depicts a standing woman gazing at a tall container of flowers. Her head is slightly tilted, revealing delicate facial features. She wears a large hat and a long flowing dress with ruffles. Surrounding her are foliage and a faintly sketched building in the background. The background is composed of lightly sketched lines and shading.

artworks.title: The Duet
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features two individuals seated in a domestic setting. They are captured from a side view, facing an object on a table. The surroundings include a table with objects and a background with soft, swirling lines indicating indoor features.

artworks.title: The Duet, No. 2
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two people seated next to each other with a musical instrument in front of them. They are both focused on the sheet music on the stand, leaning slightly forward. The sketch is monochromatic with a minimalist style, and the background includes sparse details of a room interior, with furniture lightly sketched around the central figures.

artworks.title: Stéphane Mallarmé
artworks.medium: lithograph in black with chine collé on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a monochromatic sketch of a man depicted from the waist up. He is seated, with his body angled slightly to the side and his head turned gently towards the viewer. His facial features include a prominent mustache and a straight gaze, and his hair appears short. He is dressed in what seems to be a jacket, as suggested by the texture and shading, and may have a high-collared shirt under it. The background is plain. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held. The style of the sketch is loose and impressionistic, with the figure blending subtly into the surroundings.

artworks.title: The Draped Figure, Back View
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch depicting a person from the back. The person is standing and slightly turned to the left. Their face is not visible, but some hair and a portion of the side of the face can be seen. The person is wearing a long garment that extends to their feet, detailed with light lines indicating folds and creases. There are no visible accessories or objects in their hands. The background is filled with shaded cross-hatching lines, contrasting with the lighter figure.

artworks.title: La Robe Rouge
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The sketch shows a woman sitting in a chair, with her entire body visible. She is in a relaxed seated position, with her left hand resting on the arm of the chair and her right arm bent. Her facial features are softly drawn, with gentle curves indicating her eyes, nose, and mouth. Her hair is dark and curly, covering her ears. She is wearing a long dress or gown that covers her legs. The background consists of light sketch lines suggesting the edges of the room and the back of the chair.

artworks.title: La Belle Dame endormie
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a person seated and slightly reclined, with their head leaning against an armrest or pillow on their left side. The person's eyes are closed, and their hair is short and slightly messy. They are wearing a long dress or robe that covers most of their legs. The surroundings show minimalistic elements, including a hint of drapery and faint sketch lines indicating some furnishings. The background is plain and unadorned, directing focus to the individual.

artworks.title: La Fruitière de la rue de Grenelle
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in front of a shop. The drawing depicts an entrance to a shop or café with shelves visible through the windows, filled with various objects or goods. At the forefront, there is a figure resembling a woman standing near a basket or cart, with a barrel or similar container beside her. Two animals resembling dogs are present, with one sitting and the other sniffing the ground. The background includes a partially visible window with some ornamental details, and the word "VINS" is written on one surface. The lines are casual, capturing the atmosphere of a street scene.

artworks.title: The Forge, Passage du Dragon
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: This print depicts the front of a building with several people visible inside it. The top of the building is arched, and below that is an open window with potted plants sitting on it. Below, in a wide rectangular opening, three people are partially discernible from the shoulders up. Two people on the left appear to speak with each other, while another person on the right seems to hold one hand up in the air. None of their features or clothing are distinctly outlined, and the background of the space they are in is dark. The building itself is simply sketched with minimal detailing. The background is plain, with one small shape near the bottom left corner that looks similar to a chicken standing on the ground outside the building.

artworks.title: The Smith, Passage du Dragon
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person seated behind a table, seen through a large doorway or window. Only the upper half of the person's body is visible. The individual is facing forward, with hands on or near the table. They have short hair and are wearing a dark top. The scene is in monochrome, using shades of black and grey. Above the person, there is a sketch of a decorative element. In the foreground outside the entrance, there is a small undefined shape on the ground. The surrounding area is depicted with light markings indicating a textured wall.

artworks.title: The Priest's House, Rouen
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a narrow alley or street framed by buildings. The perspective leads toward an archway in the lower half of the picture. There is no visible horizon, and the composition focuses vertically on the architectural elements. It features loose, sketch-like brushstrokes conveying texture and detail with an impressionistic quality. The color palette is monochromatic, using varying intensities of black against a light background to create depth and contrast. Close by, a few indistinct figures or objects suggest motion or life within the scene. The nearby architecture is adorned with foliage, adding organic forms to the shapes.

artworks.title: A Portrait: Mildred Howells
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a woman seated in a chair. She is shown in a side view with her body slightly turned to the left. The woman is wearing a hat with decorative elements, and her hair is pulled back. She is dressed in a long dress with puffed sleeves and a light-colored or elaborate area over the chest. Her hands are resting in her lap, and she appears composed. The background is simple and undetailed.

artworks.title: The Doctor
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The portrait sketch shows a man seated, featuring his full body from head to toe. The man has a serious expression and detailed facial features, including a mustache and dark, wavy hair. He is wearing a suit and a visible collar. The man has no visible jewelry or objects in hand. The background is plain, showing the textured surface of the paper, slightly aged in color.
